spans.s:
Pauṣkara-sādi (‘descendant of Puṣkarasādi’) is the name of a teacher mentioned in the śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka, as well as the taittirīya Prātiśākhya. A Puṣkarasādi is mentioned in the dharma sūtra of Āpastamba and elsewhere.
Foot notes vii. 17. Cf. Keith, Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society, 1908, 371.
i. 5; ii. 1, 2, 5; Pāṇini, viii. 4, 48; Vārttika, 3; Kielhorn, Indian Antiquary, 16, 103; Pischel, ibid., 34, 26.
i. 6, 19, 7; 10, 28, 1.

Pauṣpiṇḍya is the name of a teacher, a pupil of jaimini, in the vaṃśa (list of teachers) at the end of the Sāmavidhāna brāhmaṇa.
Foot notes Cf. Weber, Indische Studien, 4, 377.
